title: Cloudflare Clef's Performance Wins Hit by Heavy Rate Limiting

tickers.name: Cloudflare, Inc. Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share

summary:
Independent load tests of Cloudflare's Clef and Clef-flash decision models have identified severe throttling and timeouts during sustained usage. Testing by developers showed that requests began to fail with 429 errors and timeouts when sustained at only 5 to 8 requests per second, with failure rates reaching 1% at 8 RPS. These figures contrast with the rival TypeSafe's official Jev endpoint, which sustained over 500 RPS in short tests, while Clef added approximately 150ms of additional latency over official endpoints when hosted on Cloudflare.

Cloudflare claims its first homegrown open-weight models are 4x faster and 2x more accurate than Jev on specific benchmarks by using a frozen Qwen backbone and a specialized schema head to score answers in parallel. Clef is based on Qwen3.8-27B and Clef-flash on Qwen3.5-9B; both are Jev-API compatible and designed for classification and routing tasks in agentic workflows. The models are available as open weights on Hugging Face and hosted on Cloudflare's Workers AI platform.

selectedTweets.text:
一些实测数据：

CF 的 Clef 限流有点严重，可能是刚上线还没配太多资源：短时冲到 80 RPS 能扛住，但持续跑 15 分钟，5 RPS 就有零星 429 和超时，8 RPS 失败率到 1% 左右

CF 和 OpenRouter 的 Jev 好像都是转发到 TypeSafe 的，256 个并发也没问题。

差别在于延迟比官方多一截：CF 多约 150ms，OpenRouter 多约 400ms。CF 到 100+ RPS 时会撞上计费网关的限额，报 429，这个限制倒是和显卡无关

相比之下，TypeSafe 官方的普通账号短测跑到 500+ RPS 也没被限流，P50 一直在 300ms 内

收回之前对 Jev 带成见的简单判断，隐约有一个结论：通用判别模型本身很便宜，不过很考验团队的 Infra
